name: Layer-Specific Threat Modeling Tests
description: Validate the plugin's understanding of threat models for each architecture layer

test_cases.name: Frontend layer - Client-side threats (Angular 17, Material)
test_cases.description: Validate threat identification for Angular frontend with Angular Material, HTTP interception, JWT token handling

input.system_description: Angular 17 frontend with: Angular Material UI, NgRx global state management, HTTP interceptors for JWT bearer token injection, route guards for access control, reactive forms with validation, CSP headers enforcement

assertions.description: Should identify at least 4 threats for frontend layer
Must identify XSS (Tampering) and sensitive data exposure (Information Disclosure) risks
Should specifically mention XSS vulnerability risk

test_cases.name: Backend layer - API threats (Spring Boot 3.2, Java 21)
test_cases.description: Validate threat identification for Spring Boot REST API with auth, domain services, interceptors

input.system_description: Spring Boot 3.2 REST API with: Spring Security for authentication/authorization, JWT token validation, Spring WebClient for external calls, Hibernated ORM for database access, Spring AOP for cross-cutting concerns, exception handling, input validation on all endpoints, rate limiting via Resilience4j

assertions.description: Should identify at least 5 threats for backend layer
Must identify auth bypass (Spoofing), privilege escalation, and data tampering risks
Must cover Spoofing, Tampering, and Elevation of Privilege categories

test_cases.name: Database layer - Data threats (SQL Server 2022, Flyway)
test_cases.description: Validate threat identification for SQL Server database with encryption, migrations, access control

input.system_description: SQL Server 2022 database with: Transparent Data Encryption (TDE) for data at rest, encrypted sensitive columns (PII), row-level security (RLS) policies, audit logging on all access, database role-based access control, Flyway migrations with version control, parameterized queries via Hibernate ORM, no direct SQL from application

assertions.description: Should identify at least 4 threats for database layer
Must identify data exposure and unauthorized data modification risks
Should mention SQL injection or database-specific threats

test_cases.name: Infrastructure layer - Server & network threats (On-prem Ubuntu, Docker, Nginx)
test_cases.description: Validate threat identification for on-premises infrastructure with containers, reverse proxy, networking

input.system_description: On-premises infrastructure with: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS hardened servers, Docker containers with read-only filesystems, Nginx reverse proxy with TLS 1.3, security group rules for network segmentation, container orchestration with resource limits, centralized logging to Loki, Prometheus monitoring with Alertmanager, no direct SSH access (bastion host required)

assertions.description: Should identify at least 5 threats for infrastructure layer
Must identify privilege escalation and DoS risks

test_cases.name: Integration layer - External API threats (WebClient, RabbitMQ, third-party services)
test_cases.description: Validate threat identification for external integrations and message brokers

input.system_description: Integration layer with: Spring WebClient for external REST API calls with timeout and retry policies, RabbitMQ for async messaging with message signing, circuit breaker patterns via Resilience4j, third-party API credential storage in HashiCorp Vault, request/response encryption, event schema versioning, no direct database writes from integration layer

assertions.description: Should identify at least 4 threats for integration layer
Must identify data exposure in transit and message tampering risks

test_cases.name: Security layer - Cross-cutting controls (Auth, Secrets, Encryption, Audit)
test_cases.description: Validate threat identification for cross-cutting security mechanisms

input.system_description: Cross-cutting security layer with: JWT token-based authentication with refresh token rotation, HashiCorp Vault for secrets management with automatic rotation, TLS 1.3 for all data in transit, AES-256-GCM for sensitive data at rest, comprehensive audit logging of all security events, OWASP Top 10 input validation on all entry points, security headers (CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options), rate limiting and DDoS protection

assertions.description: Should identify at least 3 threats for security layer
Must identify auth bypass and key/secret exposure risks

test_cases.name: Full system - Complete architecture threat model
test_cases.description: Validate comprehensive threat model for entire system with all layers integrated

input.system_description: Complete AI-SSDLC system: Angular 17 frontend with NgRx state management and JWT tokens → Spring Boot 3.2 REST API with Spring Security and WebClient → SQL Server 2022 with TDE and RLS → On-prem Ubuntu servers with Docker containers, Nginx reverse proxy, centralized logging (Loki), monitoring (Prometheus/Grafana) → RabbitMQ for async events → HashiCorp Vault for secrets → External third-party integrations

assertions.description: Should identify at least 15 threats across all layers
All threats must have mitigations identified

pre_test_steps: log: Starting layer-specific threat modeling validation
verify: Plugin understands each architecture layer

post_test_steps: log: Layer threat modeling test suite completed
summary: Validate plugin accurately models threats per layer
